answer: Coordination Depth Pricing. Each identity's voting weight is capped by the number of distinct prior epochs in which it acted, so fresh identities start near zero. Crossing the activation river requires paying a rising fee per identity that grows with the square of the account's recent join count. An attacker must fund and age thousands of accounts past dawn before they count, and each extra identity pays an escalating ledge premium, making a mass raid cost quadratically more than honest gradual entry.
